title: Soul Snack #58: The Higher Logic of the Heart
excerpt: Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Sense?
bodyHtml:
Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Sense? Learn How Here.

In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav shares that authentic power begins with emotional awareness – learning to recognize the energy of your emotions as messages from your soul. The heart, he reveals, is not just a symbol of love. It is the center of deeper understanding and a source of wisdom that goes beyond the intellect.

Gary describes how most people live unaware of their emotions, stacking unacknowledged feelings like unopened letters. 

Yet every feeling – no matter how uncomfortable – carries valuable guidance about whether we are creating from love or fear. When we ignore these messages, we remain trapped in the old consciousness of reaction and pain. But when we bring awareness to them, we step into the new consciousness that is reshaping humanity itself.

The key to spiritual evolution, Gary teaches, is choosing love over fear in every moment, with every word and every action. Emotional awareness allows us to discern our intentions, respond with clarity, and live from the heart – where compassion, wisdom, and authentic power reside.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:02) — A New World Emerges
    How humanity is shifting from five-sensory perception to multisensory awareness.
  • (01:12) — The Limits of the Intellect
    Why understanding your soul requires a higher logic that originates in the heart.
  • (03:34) — The Power of Emotional Awareness
    How recognizing sensations in your body helps you decode the messages of your emotions.
  • (05:20) — Love and Fear: The Two Intentions
    Discover how every action arises from either love or fear—and how to tell the difference.
  • (06:48) — Choosing Responsibly
    Why conscious choice from love creates authentic power and meaningful consequences.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

This week, notice how your heart responds to the world around you. When you feel emotional energy – joy, irritation, sadness, or awe – pause and sense where it moves in your body. Ask yourself: Am I acting from love or from fear? Each moment of awareness strengthens your connection to the higher logic of your heart and deepens your ability to create authentically from love.
